list.name: LoadId
list.query: select distinct LoadId from TestLoad order by LoadId desc

panels.title: Como leer este dashboard
panels.description: Guia para interpretar software backlevel, ciclo de vida y soporte.

options.content: Que muestra: hosts y componentes con software backlevel, fin de soporte o fin de vida. Como interpretarlo: Backlevel, EndOfSupport y EndOfLife elevan riesgo aun cuando la capacidad este OK. Accion sugerida: priorizar upgrades por severidad, servicio afectado y fecha de soporte.

panels.title: Resumen Backlevel
panels.description: Conteo de componentes por estado de backlevel, lifecycle y soporte.

targets.rawSql: select BacklevelStatus, LifecycleStatus, SupportStatus, count(*) as HostCount from EnterpriseTechnologyComponent where LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' group by BacklevelStatus, LifecycleStatus, SupportStatus order by case BacklevelStatus when 'Backlevel' then 1 when 'Current' then 2 else 3 end, LifecycleStatus

panels.title: Software Backlevel por Host
panels.description: Detalle de hosts con version, vendor, fin de soporte y servicio afectado para planificar upgrades.

targets.rawSql: select ComponentName as HostName, TechnologyType, Version, Vendor, DomainName, BusinessServiceId, BacklevelStatus, LifecycleStatus, SupportStatus, EndOfSupportDate from EnterpriseTechnologyComponent where LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and (BacklevelStatus = 'Backlevel' or LifecycleStatus in ('EndOfSupport','EndOfLife')) order by EndOfSupportDate nulls last, ComponentName

panels.title: Riesgos y Acciones Backlevel
panels.description: Riesgos lifecycle asociados a software backlevel con impacto y accion recomendada.

targets.rawSql: select r.Severity, c.ComponentName as HostName, c.BacklevelStatus, c.LifecycleStatus, c.EndOfSupportDate, r.Impact, r.RecommendedAction, r.EvidenceState from EnterpriseRiskRegistryEntry r join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentId = r.AffectedTechnologyId where r.LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and r.RiskCategory = 'Lifecycle' order by case r.Severity when 'Critical' then 1 when 'High' then 2 when 'Medium' then 3 else 4 end, c.EndOfSupportDate nulls last
